================================================================================
Paren-less if with a single-line applied condition (control)
================================================================================

val x = Some(10)

def f =
   if x.exists(x => x == 10) then
      println("Yes")
   else
      println("No")

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(compilation_unit
  (val_definition
    (identifier)
    (call_expression
      (identifier)
      (arguments
        (integer_literal))))
  (function_definition
    (identifier)
    (indented_block
      (if_expression
        (call_expression
          (field_expression
            (identifier)
            (identifier))
          (arguments
            (lambda_expression
              (identifier)
              (infix_expression
                (identifier)
                (operator_identifier)
                (integer_literal)))))
        (indented_block
          (call_expression
            (identifier)
            (arguments
              (string))))
        (indented_block
          (call_expression
            (identifier)
            (arguments
              (string))))))))

================================================================================
Paren-less if with an applied condition split across lines (sloplint SC-PARENIF)
================================================================================

val x = Some(10)

def f =
   if x.exists
         (x => x == 10) then
      println("Yes")
   else
      println("No")

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(compilation_unit
  (val_definition
    (identifier)
    (call_expression
      (identifier)
      (arguments
        (integer_literal))))
  (function_definition
    (identifier)
    (indented_block
      (if_expression
        (split_call_condition
          (field_expression
            (identifier)
            (identifier))
          (arguments
            (lambda_expression
              (identifier)
              (infix_expression
                (identifier)
                (operator_identifier)
                (integer_literal)))))
        (indented_block
          (call_expression
            (identifier)
            (arguments
              (string))))
        (indented_block
          (call_expression
            (identifier)
            (arguments
              (string))))))))
